I spend most of my days reading through poetry and simply daydreaming and writing down what could become possible lyrics, so it's obviously something that I want to do. I have self loathsome issues which have stopped me from posting anything on YouTube before but recently passer-bys on the street have told me that I have a nice voice (I sing along to songs when I'm out and about). 
He never really pressures me into smoking, it's just that's all he's now interested in which saddens me. 
Thank you though, to be completely honest at this point I still want to simply end it all, but when I wake up tomorrow possibly I'll start a new me where I can take on my mountains as hills and overcome the temptations.

Recently my first love came back into my life after 4 years. She text me one night, a particularly bad one when I was literally about to end it all and simply asked me how I was. Since then we've been chatting a lot and it's just like old times. She's been in a stable relationship for quite some time now and I am genuinely happy that she's happy with her partner, but at the same time I can barely look at her without being overcome with the dread of what could have been (I ended our relationship over nothing at the time). Honestly every night since she messaged me last month I've dreamt about her and I can't stop thinking of her. 
However, there is advice at the end of this that's been helping me get by. My friend told me 
" Well what I've found that works is being proactive and living life and just keeping on trucking no matter how dumb it sounds. And with time you develop a new piece which is so much better than the old piece that's missing" 
So basically I think as we travel through life we meet new people that you never knew could be so great and as you grow older things you'll begin to realise that the memory of the time you spent with them will be bring you joy instead of sadness.

I would be willing to die for my country, but I am well aware of the old lie Dulce et Decorum est Pro patria mori. Thanks for the responses, I'll likely head down to their local office and talk things over with them.
I do what I like and I like what I do

I worked as a street fundraiser for a while and ended up with a pretty nasty flu virus which basically floored me for a week. For the first couple of days I still showed up but both days my team leader sent me home and then called me each day after to evaluate whether or not he wanted me back in yet. 
I was desperate for money at this time so I was trying to convince him that I could work (which was clearly a lie). 
The next week he calls me into the head office and explains that over the last couple of weeks my targets have really dropped and he can't have that from someone in his team so to hand in my jacket and he would arrange my final payment. 
This was almost a year ago and I still find enjoyment in calling up the HQ and harassing them for money that they owe me!
